# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `aisa` MCP server pointing at AIsa's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.aisa.one/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and AIsa sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: AIsa's official app icon from aisa.one.
